description: Ex-9 Squadron Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104A preserved at King Hussein air base, Mafraq, home of the Royal Jordanian Air Academy. Construction number 183-1079, ex USAF 56-791. Independently corroborated by an OpenStreetMap historic aircraft node at 32.35424N 36.24645E and by the International F-104 Society, which lists it at the King Hussein Air College.

Royal Jordanian Air Force Scottish Aviation Bulldog 125A, construction number BH.120/434, preserved at King Hussein air base about 400 m south-west of the Starfighter. The spottingmode location and airframe record were both refreshed on 25 January 2026, which makes this one of the best-dated preservation records in Jordan.
